t: This is the Henry Smith Charity, a London-based charity founded in 1628 from the will of Henry Smith, a moneylender and landowner who lived from 1549 to 1628. Legend gave him the nickname Dog, from a story that he once spent time as a beggar with a dog for company. He lent to notable property owners and built up estates of thousands of acres. In his will he left money for the poor, for his sister's descendants, for victims of the Barbary slave trade, and for clergymen. The charity survives today.
